tokens.paperTop: The paper: the ground of every screen. Text on it is ink or inkSecondary.
tokens.cardFill: The fill of every card, sheet and dialog (see the Card component).
tokens.surfaceSunken: A ground sunk below the paper, such as a track behind a control.
tokens.hairline: The one point edge round a card.
tokens.divider: The one pixel line between rows inside a card.
tokens.ink: Text and the interactive colour on paper and on cards. Never a brand hue.
tokens.inkSecondary: Secondary lines and every label (section, field, toggle), on paper and cards.
tokens.inkFaintIcon: A dimmed glyph with no text of its own; it clears the contrast floor for marks that are not text. Never for text.
tokens.iconInk: The app icon's line art, warmer than ink so it holds on any highlighter.
tokens.accent: The interactive colour on paper is ink; there is no brand hue (#1676).
tokens.onAccent: Text and glyphs on an accent (ink) fill.
tokens.marker: The one bright colour, butter by default. Views read the musician's chosen highlighter, never this token directly. A fill only, with ink on it; never text on paper, where it all but vanishes.
tokens.marker-butter: The butter highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-coral: The coral highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-mint: The mint highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-sky: The sky highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-lavender: The lavender highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-sage: The sage highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-peach: The peach highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.marker-powder: The powder highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.
tokens.onMarker: Text and glyphs on the highlighter fill.
tokens.danger: Destructive actions and errors: a brick red pulled toward brown.
tokens.dangerWash: A wash of danger shared by an error banner and what it points at.
tokens.dangerBanner: A wash of danger: the error banner's fill.
tokens.dangerEdge: A faded danger: the edge of a danger surface.
tokens.shadow: A faint ink: the colour of the card lift.
tokens.buttonShadow: A faint ink: the colour of the primary button lift.
tokens.sheetScrim: A faded black: the dimmed ground behind a floating sheet.
tokens.pieceBadgeBg: Blue-grey: a piece's badge and bar. Duller than the marker so a badge never reads as a button.
tokens.exerciseBadgeBg: Sand: an exercise's badge and bar. Duller than the marker so a badge never reads as a button.
tokens.success: Mastery gains, clean reps, trending up: an olive green. Kept apart from danger.
tokens.masteryFill: Mastery is monochrome ink; the count carries the meaning. Never recolour by level.
tokens.masteryTrack: The empty track of a mastery meter.
tokens.dialTrack: The empty track of a dial.
tokens.timerTrack: The empty track of the session timer.
tokens.consistencyTrack: The empty track of the consistency chart.
tokens.slotOutline: An empty rep slot's ring and the missed button's border.
tokens.addDashOutline: The dashed outline on full-width add rows.
tokens.inkFainter: A very faint ink for marks, not text.
tokens.playerBgTop: The top stop of the focus player's warm radial backdrop.
tokens.playerBgMid: The middle stop of the focus player's backdrop.
tokens.playerBgBottom: The outer stop of the focus player's backdrop.
tokens.heroGradientTop: The top of the Practice hero card's gradient.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-butter: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the butter highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-coral: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the coral highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-mint: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the mint highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-sky: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the sky highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-lavender: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the lavender highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-sage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the sage highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-peach: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the peach highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.heroGradientBottom-powder: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the powder highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.
tokens.onHeroExercise: An exercise's accent on the dark hero.
tokens.onHeroPiece: A piece's accent on the dark hero.
tokens.viewerBackdrop: The full-screen photo viewer's ground: a warm near-black, so cream never tints a photograph.
tokens.spacing-cardCompact: IntradaSpacing.cardCompact: a card's inset in a dense list.
tokens.spacing-card: IntradaSpacing.card: a card's inset from its edge.
tokens.radius-card: IntradaRadius.card: every card and inset surface, and the primary button.
tokens.radius-control: IntradaRadius.control: interactive control buttons (rep Clean and Missed).
tokens.radius-badge: IntradaRadius.badge: type badges and small tinted chips.
tokens.radius-panel: IntradaRadius.panel: medium section and hero cards.
tokens.radius-hero: IntradaRadius.hero: the Practice hero, the largest card.
tokens.shadow-card: IntradaShadow.card: the faint lift under every card on paper, in the shadow colour.
tokens.shadow-button: IntradaShadow.button: the primary button's lift, in the buttonShadow colour.
tokens.shadow-lifted: IntradaShadow.lifted: a control while the musician drags it.
tokens.shadow-glow: IntradaShadow.glow: a soft glow in the accent (ink).
tokens.shadow-transport: IntradaShadow.transport: the lift under the player's transport controls.
tokens.shadow-heroButton: IntradaShadow.heroButton: the lift under a button on the dark hero.
tokens.shadow-hero: IntradaShadow.hero: the Practice hero, the only card that floats this far.
tokens.shadow-appIcon: IntradaShadow.appIcon: the app icon's lift, in ink at the wash opacity.
tokens.spacing-segmentGap: IntradaSpacing.segmentGap: between the segments of a strip, and the strip and its labels.
tokens.opacity-wash: IntradaOpacity.wash: a faint tint washing a surface, such as a pressed capsule or a card on a dark hero.
tokens.opacity-dimmed: IntradaOpacity.dimmed: a row or figure that is disabled, unplayed or superseded.
tokens.opacity-soft: IntradaOpacity.soft: a softened fill or edge that still reads as the colour it came from, such as the ends of the title swipe.
tokens.opacity-secondary: IntradaOpacity.secondary: secondary text or glyphs on a dark or photographic ground.
tokens.opacity-strong: IntradaOpacity.strong: a ground or text that must hold contrast over anything beneath it.
tokens.icon-badge: IntradaIconSize.badge: a glyph inside a badge or count chip.
tokens.icon-caption: IntradaIconSize.caption: a glyph beside small text, such as the priority star on a library row.
tokens.icon-inline: IntradaIconSize.inline: a glyph beside body text, and the plus in the round add button.
tokens.icon-control: IntradaIconSize.control: a glyph that is a control on its own, such as the back chevron.
tokens.icon-large: IntradaIconSize.large: a large glyph, such as an empty state's picture.
tokens.icon-transport: IntradaIconSize.transport: the player's play and skip glyphs.
tokens.icon-hero: IntradaIconSize.hero: the largest glyph, on a hero.
tokens.glyph-bar: IntradaGlyph.bar: the instrument icon in the header button.
tokens.glyph-tile: IntradaGlyph.tile: the instrument icon on a picker tile.
tokens.glyph-hero: IntradaGlyph.hero: the instrument icon on the profile hero.

styles.pageTitle: The page title, the largest of the five sizes.
styles.title: A hero heading or the key picker.
styles.body: Body text, values and fields: anything the musician reads or sets, in ink.
styles.label: Names a section, a field or a toggle, above what it names, in inkSecondary, sentence case.
styles.figure: A value that is only a number: a clock, a duration, a count.
styles.smallMedium: Tabs, badges and chips with emphasis.

families.shadow: From IntradaShadow (colour, radius, y). A SwiftUI shadow radius is not a CSS blur; the blur here is the SwiftUI radius written as is.
